content.title: Silhouette State Relay | Transformation Flash to Completed Attack Arc
content.summary: Establish a movement baseline through readable tool and cloak silhouettes, then progress through countable landing poses. Use one central flash only as the state handoff, prove the new state through effect action and displacement, and return to a readable landing.

quick_start.input_format: Original action body + clear tool outline + 2 landing action geometries + 1 occlusion and shape change + effect action and displacement proof + landing final state
quick_start.recommended_input: The pottery kiln maintenance robot is outlined with long clamps and heat shields to complete two landing maintenance postures; after a steam block, it reveals a cooling configuration, cuts joints along the service rail, and then lands next to the sealed kiln door.
required_anchors: Establish one countable full-body action silhouette and its tool before escalation.
Advance through at least two materially different grounded action geometries.
Prove the later state through both a committed effect action and a displaced body path.
End on a readable grounded state that recalls at least one opening silhouette anchor.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a movement baseline through readable tool and cloak silhouettes, then progress through countable landing poses. Use one central flash only as the state handoff, prove the new state through effect action and displacement, and return to a readable landing.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Stage one graphic action display as a sequence of countable full-body proof states: establish a weapon-and-cape silhouette, vary grounded attack geometry, use one central flash to hand off into a visibly different form state without asserting identity continuity, prove the new state through one energy arc and one airborne passage, then return to a readable grounded endpoint.

invariants.rule: Establish one countable full-body action silhouette and its tool before escalation.
invariants.purpose: Creates a comparison baseline for later proof poses.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning with a flare makes the form change unreadable.

invariants.rule: Advance through at least two materially different grounded action geometries.
invariants.purpose: Shows action progression rather than a decorative pose loop.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated near-identical poses create no escalation.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one occluding transition to hand off between visible form states without claiming hidden identity continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unmarked form swap looks accidental; claiming identity exceeds the visible proof.

invariants.rule: Prove the later state through both a committed effect action and a displaced body path.
invariants.purpose: Makes the new state operational rather than cosmetic.
invariants.ablation_failure: A costume-only reveal lacks a functional proof.

invariants.rule: End on a readable grounded state that recalls at least one opening silhouette anchor.
invariants.purpose: Closes the action display as a complete arc.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending mid-flight leaves the state chain unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source black void and exact attack poses
